name: Photo Studio
detailed_description:
Photo Studio is your one-way ticket to living the dream:
📸 Top models? ✔
💡 Fancy lighting rigs? ✔
🎶 Custom music playlist? ✔
👗 Full creative control over wardrobe, makeup, and... poses? Oh yes.

You’re not just a photographer — you’re the photographer. The one all the models are texting. Your studio? Packed with gear so advanced, it probably has its own OnlyFans.

VR and NON-VR gameplay included
(If your headset is tired, just turn it off — the studio still runs without it. You're welcome, introverts.)

🌟 What can you do?

  • Walk around your stylish photo mansion

  • Play with pro lighting like a real fashion diva

  • Snap photos with digital filters, zoom, angles — all that good stuff

  • Record sexy music video content (or awkward dance fails — your choice)

  • Pose your models like they’re in Vogue meets K-pop meets TikTok

  • Customize everything: clothes, makeup, hair, eye color — even mood

You can switch between your fabulous models: Anya, Albina, Cristy, and more — or even play as a model yourself (NON-VR mode). Yup, you’re both the star and the one yelling “work it!” from behind the lens.

💃 What about the moves?

We’re talking animations on animations:

  • Glamorous fashion poses

  • Seductive club dances

  • K-pop routines so catchy your fingers will dance too

  • Billboard-inspired hits like “Toxic”, “Poker Face”, and “Boombayah”

  • Even wholesome cute vibes from songs like “Me Gustas Tu” and “Like Ooh Ahh”

Whether it’s hot, adorable, or chaotically fabulous, your model will nail it with over 160+ dance and pose animations. All with facial expressions that go from sultry to “oops I blinked.”

💡 Light. Camera. Sass.

Adjust intensity, color temperature, direction — all from your fancy control panel. Ceiling lamps, floor spotlights, studio glows — you'll feel like a lighting wizard with a very glamorous wand.

🎮 NON-VR Perks

  • Play as male or female

  • Full-body player model with dressing options

  • Walk, idle, strut like you own the place

  • Yes, you can match your outfit to your mood

Photo Studio is the ultimate creative sandbox for photography lovers, dance fans, and people who just want to tell models what to do all day. Whether you're staging a glamorous shoot or filming a neon-lit music video — this is your stage.

Now grab your camera, cue your playlist, and strike a pose.
The spotlight's on you.

short_description: Photo Studio – Step into the spotlight (or behind the camera) and live your best photographer life! Glamour, lighting, models, dance moves, and total creative control. VR or not, it’s time to strike a pose and own the shoot.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later (64-BIT Required!!!) It is not working on 32-BIT systems!
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
